body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 07ae6e14e8f5139045a0d30ab8d9647a9d2ab23c -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (with one scope note below for the maintainer to decide).

Thanks for this, mkinney.

**What looks good**
- Every pick add/toggle site now reads the platform command modifier: `edge_pick.rs:22,25,27`, `feature_click.rs:191`, `interact.rs:164,171`. `Mods.ctrl` is renamed to `Mods.command`, so a missed site would not compile. No `.ctrl` read is left in `crates/ui/src`.
- The shell builds `Mods` from egui via one `From` impl (`interact.rs:57`, used at `shell.rs:423`). `shell.rs` actually shrank by 4 lines. `interact.rs` is +23 lines in the diff and is already far over the limit at 1754 lines (non-blocking).
- On Windows and Linux egui sets `command` whenever Ctrl is held, so Ctrl still adds there. On macOS Control alone no longer adds, so Ctrl+click (the secondary click) cannot become an add. The `ModifiersState` impl uses `super_key` on macOS, `control_key` elsewhere. Only the egui impl is used in the app.
- The pick-through toggle (#1204) and the one pick rule are untouched. The `one_pick_rule` / pick_through lib tests pass.
- No snapshot PNG changed. Only `crates/ui` and a decision note changed; no new dependency or build.rs, no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` added outside tests, no layering change.

**Local results** (merged with current `origin/main`, clean merge, no conflicts)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | builds |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 616 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| `--test boundary_picks` | 6 passed |
| `--test edge_loop_pick` | 3 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. **Hint text still names Ctrl and is not covered elsewhere.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/geo_page.rs:20` (`EDGE_HINT`: "Ctrl+click adds an edge..."), `geo_page.rs:30` (hover text "Ctrl adds") and `egui_app/boundary.rs:41` ("Ctrl-click to add or remove one"). The decision note defers these to #1239, but PR #1293 (the #1239 PR) does not touch `geo_page.rs` or `boundary.rs`; it only changes machines_pane, op_page, panes, tests, lib, `shortcut_keys.rs` and state. So these strings fall between the two PRs. #1238's "Done means" asks for the hints to name the right key and for a docs update, and neither is in this PR, so `Fixes #1238` would close the issue early. Suggest `Refs #1238`, or have #1293 (or a follow-up) cover these three strings. There is no code conflict with #1293 (disjoint files).
2. Stale wording in comments: `boundary_draft.rs:7-8,331` and `shell.rs:261` still say "Ctrl". `edge_pick.rs:2-4` has an over-long doc line.
3. The new test `the_command_modifier_from_egui_toggles_and_control_alone_does_not` builds `egui::Modifiers { ctrl: true, .. }` with `command` left false. That models macOS, but on Windows/Linux egui would set `command` too, so it checks the mapping only. The macOS behaviour is untested on hardware, as the decision note says.
4. The body should carry a `Changelog:` line if it lacks one.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
